items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 90:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the Malchut of Ima that is not included in the Mochin of ZA? In these Mochin of AB that ZA receives from the Aba and Ima of AB, which come out upon the MAN of the Mazalot, the Nukva has no share in them, but they belong to ZA alone. And the Mochin of the Nukva begin to come out in the head of ZA, and there is the beginning of their coming out, and they have no grip in the essence of the Mochin of ZA, but they come out there upon a new coupling made in the aspect of the Malchut of Ima, which was not included in the Mochin of ZA, and not upon the aspect of the crown of Gevura of the Mochin of ZA himself.
